title: Mechanics IR schema + validation
objective: Implement ProblemIR dataclasses with constraints, supported-subset rejection, and serialization.
implementation_steps: Define ProblemIR as immutable dataclass with fields: dim, formulation, element_type, material, boundaries, coordinates
Implement construction-time validation (dimension consistency, supported element types, valid formulations)
Implement supported-subset rejection: raise with specific plan phase for unsupported constructs
Implement JSON/dict serialization for golden comparisons
Write round-trip and invalid-input rejection tests
acceptance_criteria: Schema round-trip: IR -> dict -> IR preserves all fields
Invalid inputs rejected with actionable error messages
Unsupported constructs (e.g., Updated Lagrangian) raise with plan phase reference

cases: Unsupported formulation raises with plan phase
Unsupported element type raises with plan phase

risks: IR schema changes may cascade to downstream tasks (P4.3, P5.1, P6.2) — freeze schema early
